name: @predictefy/mcp

tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: List the 16 prediction-market venues this deployment serves, with per-venue capability notes (order-book tier, public trades tape availability). Some venues are data-only: read the notes before assuming a trading lane exists. A venue that is implemented but dark is not served here, so it is absent from this list and any call naming it answers EXCHANGE_NOT_AVAILABLE.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Search prediction markets by text query on one venue, or across ALL venues when venue is omitted. Returns unified market objects with outcome prices, all eight price-change windows (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d, 30d, always present as number or null), and tape coverage metadata. Accepts range filters for all eight windows.

venue.description: Venue id (omit to search ALL venues). One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

priceChange1m.description: Filter by outcome probability delta over past 1m (order-book tape).

priceChange15m.description: Filter by outcome probability delta over past 15m (order-book tape).

priceChange6h.description: Filter by outcome probability delta over past 6h (candle history).

priceChange24h.description: Filter by outcome probability delta over past 24h (candle history).

priceChange7d.description: Filter by outcome probability delta over past 7d (candle/official history).

priceChange30d.description: Filter by outcome probability delta over past 30d (candle/official history).

venue.description: Venue id (omit to search ALL venues). One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

venue.description: Venue id. One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

address.description: Venue wallet address or trader account identifier.

venue.description: Venue id (omit to search ALL venues). One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

category.description: Trader category filter, such as whale.

cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor from the prior page.

tools.name: get_matches
tools.description: Find the SAME real-world market or event on other venues. `scope=market` returns cross-venue market matches for an anchor (marketId or slug) or a browse page when no anchor is given; `scope=event` returns EVENT-grain matches (discovery/navigation only — no prices at event grain); `scope=related` returns verified subset/superset outcome-implication edges for one anchor. Scores are `similarity`, never confidence. Stored matcher output, not live books. Each scope forwards its OWN anchor and filters; passing one another scope owns is REFUSED rather than silently ignored.

marketId.description: scope=market/related only: anchor market id (omit to browse on market).

slug.description: scope=market/related only: anchor slug (alternative to marketId).

eventId.description: scope=event only: canonical "{venue}:{eventId}" anchor (omit to browse).

minSimilarity.description: scope=market/event only: minimum raw cosine similarity 0..1.

query.description: scope=market/event only: keyword filter over the match/cluster title.

relations.description: scope=related only: comma-separated relation filter (subset, superset).

legacyAlias.description: scope=market only: call the DEPRECATED /api/router/fetchMatches alias instead of fetchMarketMatches. Identical request/response — for compatibility checks only.

tools.name: get_matched_markets
tools.description: Browse matched cross-venue market PAIRS with their INDICATIVE price difference — observed stored mid-price gaps, never an executable arbitrage claim. Filter by category, minimum similarity, or a minimum price difference. Use get_arbitrage for live, depth-and-fee-gated executability.

minSimilarity.description: Minimum raw cosine similarity 0..1 (a matcher score, never a calibrated confidence).

minDifference.description: Drop pairs whose indicative priceDifference is below this (0..1).

query.description: Keyword filter over the pair title.

legacyAlias.description: Call the DEPRECATED /api/router/fetchMatchedPrices alias instead of fetchMatchedMarkets. Identical request/response — compatibility checks only.

tools.name: compare_market_prices
tools.description: Cross-venue INDICATIVE price view for ONE anchor market. `kind=venues` returns the anchor's per-venue snapshot prices; `kind=hedges` returns indicative hedge CANDIDATES (the opposite No side on matched venues). Requires marketId or slug. Indicative only — not executable quotes.

kind.description: venues = per-venue prices (default); hedges = opposite-side candidates.

marketId.description: Anchor market id. Cluster verbs want the canonical "{venue}:{marketId}" form.

live.description: kind=venues only: recompute from live order-book mids where enabled.

tools.name: get_clusters
tools.description: Cross-venue matched CLUSTERS (the same market/event grouped across venues, with a stable clusterId). `kind=canonical` reads the /v1/clusters projection, which supports ONLY category, hasDiscrepancy, sort, limit, and offset — pass clusterId for one cluster with its per-venue members. `kind=market` / `kind=event` read the router cluster views, which additionally accept the anchor and relation/venue filters. Passing a filter the chosen kind cannot honor is REFUSED rather than silently ignored. Scores are `similarity`.

clusterId.description: kind=canonical only: fetch ONE cluster with its members. Takes no list filters or paging — pass it alone.

query.description: kind=market/event only: keyword filter over the cluster title.

relations.description: kind=market/event only: comma-separated relation filter (identity, subset, superset).

minSimilarity.description: kind=market/event only: minimum raw cosine similarity 0..1.

minVenues.description: kind=market/event only: clusters spanning at least N venues.

hasDiscrepancy.description: Only clusters carrying an indicative price discrepancy.

tools.name: get_discrepancies
tools.description: INDICATIVE cross-venue price discrepancies (never "arbitrage"): observed mid-price gaps per cluster. Pass `clusterId` AND `size` to run the fail-closed QUALIFICATION instead — live evidence walked across the paired YES/NO asks at that USDC size, which fails closed rather than guessing. `live=true` recomputes the list from live order-book mids.

clusterId.description: With `size`: qualify THIS cluster against live books instead of listing.

size.description: Qualification only: total USDC size walked across the paired asks.

category.description: LIST only: canonical category filter (a qualification reads one cluster).

live.description: LIST only: recompute from live order-book mids (qualification is always live).

expand_markets.description: LIST only: adds catalog market metadata (title, venue, status, closeDate, image, volume24h, liquidity) to every leg at no extra metering weight.

limit.description: LIST only: max rows (stored cap: 100; live cap: 10).

tools.name: get_arbitrage
tools.description: Assess discrepancy clusters against LIVE order books at a given position size — the snapshot equivalent of the WebSocket arbitrage stream (the MCP has no streaming surface). Each row is judged on live asks, open markets, depth, fees/gas, and resolution equivalence. Set `executableOnly` to serve ONLY rows that passed every gate; rows that did not pass remain INDICATIVE price discrepancies, not arbitrage.

contracts.description: Position size to assess; depth and fees are judged at this size.

executableOnly.description: Serve only rows that passed every executable-arbitrage gate.

venue.description: Keep rows whose YES or NO leg touches this product venue.

tools.name: get_catalog_metadata
tools.description: Catalog metadata beyond market/event lookup. `kind`: `categories` and `tags` return the Predictefy canonical taxonomy; `series` lists venue series (empty where a venue has none); `event-metadata` returns venue-native event metadata (Kalshi today — other venues answer NOT_SUPPORTED honestly); `capabilities` returns the venue capability map (`has`), where each verb is true, false, or 'emulated'; `markets` and `events` are the cursor-paginated catalog pages (pass `cursor` to walk them). `capabilities` and `event-metadata` require a venue; the rest default to the ALL-venues router.

venue.description: Venue id (omit for the ALL-venues router). One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

category.description: kind=tags: narrow to one category. kind=series/markets/events: filter.

cursor.description: kind=series/markets/events only: opaque cursor from the prior page.

limit.description: kind=series/markets/events only — categories, tags, capabilities, and event-metadata are unpaginated. Max rows (server-side cap: 100).

tools.name: get_orderbooks
tools.description: Fetch live order books for MANY outcomes on one venue in a single call, returned as an outcomeId → book map. Use this instead of looping get_orderbook. Emulated-book venues return a reconstructed top-of-book level — indicative, not executable.

venue.description: Venue id. One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

outcomeIds.description: Comma-separated unified outcome ids (server-side cap: 100 ids).

tools.name: get_execution_price
tools.description: STATELESS calculator: compute the volume-weighted execution price to fill `size` on a book you pass in (typically straight from get_orderbook). `detailed` adds the partial-fill breakdown (filledAmount, fullyFilled). Nothing is built, signed, or submitted — use exec_quote when you want the book fetched for you.

venue.description: Venue id. One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

orderBook.description: An order book object as returned by get_orderbook (bids/asks levels). Each side is bounded to the deepest 100 levels, matching the get_orderbook depth clamp; a longer side is trimmed and the trim is reported.

detailed.description: true = VWAP plus the partial-fill breakdown; false = the bare price.

tools.name: filter_catalog
tools.description: PURE stateless filter over rows YOU pass in (typically from search_markets or get_events): returns the matching subset. `criteria` is either a plain string (title substring) or a structured object — markets accept text/searchIn/volume/liquidity/openInterest/resolutionDate/category/tags/price and priceChange ranges for all eight windows (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d, 30d); events accept text/searchIn/category/tags/marketCount/totalVolume. Nothing is fetched.

kind.description: Which row shape you are filtering.

items.description: The market or event rows to filter (server-side cap: 100 rows; an oversized list is trimmed and the trim is reported).

criteria.description: A title substring, or a structured filter object (supporting price and priceChange1m..priceChange30d ranges).

tools.name: get_wallet_trades
tools.description: Fetch ONE wallet's venue-scoped trade history with keyset pagination. Complements get_wallet_profile (statistics/score) with the underlying tape. Returns the venue honest TRADERS_UNSUPPORTED error where trader identity isn't available.

venue.description: Venue id. One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

address.description: Venue wallet address or trader account identifier.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the prior page.

tools.name: get_feed_data
tools.description: Data Feeds are REFERENCE price sources (Binance spot, Chainlink oracles) — NOT prediction-market venues; use the venue tools for markets. `kind`: `list` (feed directory + honest capability maps), `markets` (static reference-market metadata), `ticker` / `tickers` (one or many symbols), `ohlcv` (candles), `oracle-round` / `oracle-history` (decoded Chainlink rounds), `historical-prices` (timestamp-ranged prices), `orderbook` (a PERMANENT capability gap — reference feeds publish prices, not depth, so it always answers 501 NOT_SUPPORTED).

feed.description: Feed id: 'binance' or 'chainlink'. Required for every kind except `list`.

symbols.description: kind=tickers: comma-separated symbols (omit for the curated set).

fromTimestamp.description: kind=historical-prices: inclusive lower bound, epoch SECONDS.

untilTimestamp.description: kind=historical-prices: inclusive upper bound, epoch SECONDS.

order.description: kind=historical-prices: sort by upstream event time (default desc).

limit.description: kind=ohlcv/oracle-history/historical-prices ONLY — the other feeds verbs are unpaginated upstream. Max rows (candles cap 5000; other lists cap 100).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read one venue account resource. `kind`: `capabilities` (what this venue exposes and whether it needs owner auth — call it first, it needs no accountId), `snapshot` (all resources at once), or the paged `balances` / `positions` / `open-orders` / `fills`. Everything except `capabilities` needs an `accountId` (a public address, or the literal "owner" on owner-authenticated venues). Owner-authenticated venues answer with an honest NOT_SUPPORTED that names the credential you would need — this hosted server holds no venue credentials, so it serves PUBLIC account data only.

venue.description: Venue id. One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

accountId.description: Public account address (required for every kind except `capabilities`).

limit.description: kind=balances/positions/open-orders/fills only — capabilities and snapshot are unpaginated. Max rows (server-side cap: 100).

cursor.description: kind=balances/positions/open-orders/fills only: opaque cursor from the prior page.

tools.name: get_funding
tools.description: INFORMATIONAL funding and bridge lookups — these return descriptions and progress, never a transaction to sign. `kind=requirements` reports what a venue needs before it can trade (chain, collateral token, approval spender and kind, deposit step). `kind=bridge-status` polls a transfer you already broadcast, by hash — note it relays the bridge provider's status payload VERBATIM, so its artifact-freedom is provider-shaped rather than structurally enforced by Predictefy. The reads that return CALLER-SIGNABLE artifacts — transfer plans, bridge quotes, and bridge sessions — are on get_funding_artifacts, which is armed with the execution surface.

kind.description: Which informational funding/bridge read to run.

venue.description: kind=requirements: the venue to describe.

tools.name: get_platform_metadata
tools.description: Platform-wide singletons. `kind`: `portfolio` (one bounded cross-venue valuation for a PUBLIC address), `mappings` (bulk venue+marketId → canonical marketPk/clusterId/status, for correlating WebSocket frames with catalog identity — unknown pairs resolve to null), `venue-metrics` (latest source-qualified venue size metrics).

address.description: kind=portfolio: the public address to value.

venue.description: kind=venue-metrics: narrow to one venue.

pairs.description: kind=mappings: the (venue, marketId) pairs to resolve.

tools.name: run_sql
tools.description: Run ONE read-only SQL statement against the Predictefy warehouse. Requires an API key carrying the `sql` scope — the SERVER enforces that plus read-only access; a key without the scope gets an honest authorization error here. Use it for aggregate analysis the typed tools cannot express; prefer the typed tools when one fits.

tools.name: get_webhooks
tools.description: Read this account's registered webhook endpoints (`kind=endpoints`) or one endpoint's delivery history (`kind=deliveries`, oldest-to-newest, cursor-paged via `after`). Signing secrets are NEVER returned on reads — the secret is shown exactly once, at creation.

kind.description: endpoints = the registered targets (default); deliveries = one target log.

after.description: kind=deliveries: stable delivery id to page after.

tools.name: manage_webhook
tools.description: WRITE tool for this account's own webhook endpoints. BOTH actions PREVIEW by default and do nothing unless `confirm` is exactly true. `action=create` registers a public https target for the given events and returns the signing `secret` ONE TIME — store it immediately, it is never shown again. `action=delete` removes an endpoint and cascades its delivery history; deleting an id that is not this account's 404s. Registration and delivery are both SSRF-guarded server-side.

action.description: create a target, or delete one.

events.description: action=create: comma-separated event names, e.g. ingest.run.completed, matcher.run.completed, execution.status.changed.

id.description: action=delete: the endpoint id to remove.

confirm.description: MUST be exactly true to actually create or delete. Omitted or false = PREVIEW (nothing is registered or removed).

tools.name: create_billing_session
tools.description: Open a hosted Stripe session for THIS account and return its URL for a human to open. No money moves here — this only creates the session; the purchase happens when a person completes checkout in a browser. `kind=checkout` buys a credit pack (`packId`), `kind=subscribe` starts a plan subscription (`planId`), `kind=portal` opens the customer portal to manage an existing subscription and payment methods.

kind.description: checkout = credit pack, subscribe = plan, portal = manage existing.

tools.name: exec_quote
tools.description: PREVIEW the fill price + notional for an intended order against the LIVE order book — a pure read: nothing is built, signed, or submitted. Fetches the outcome book, then computes the volume-weighted execution price and fillable size for `side` × `size`. Indicative only; the authoritative notional + fee estimate + spend-cap check come from exec_prepare. This tool can never spend — to trade you must exec_prepare then exec_submit.

venue.description: Venue id. One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

outcomeId.description: Unified outcome id to price (from market.outcomes[].outcomeId).

tools.name: exec_prepare
tools.description: BUILD an unsigned, venue-shaped order via the ISOLATED execution service. Returns the UNSIGNED artifact + executionId + notional + fee estimate. NOTHING is signed here — the server holds no key. Sign the returned `unsigned` artifact with YOUR OWN wallet, then call exec_submit. Requires the `trade` scope; the server enforces per-order + daily spend caps and rejects out-of-bounds artifacts.

venue.description: Venue id. One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable client-chosen idempotency key. Reuse it so retries are idempotent — it is NEVER auto-generated (a fresh key per retry breaks idempotency).

order.description: Venue-shaped build input (e.g. the venue SDK build result). Forwarded verbatim to the execution BUILD endpoint.

tools.name: exec_submit
tools.description: RELAY a CLIENT-signed order to the venue via the ISOLATED execution service. DRY-RUN BY DEFAULT: without `confirm: true` this previews the submission and sends NOTHING. Set `confirm: true` to actually submit. Requires the `trade` scope + an Idempotency-Key; the server re-checks spend caps and validates that the signature matches the order built at exec_prepare (no bait-and-switch). The signature is produced by YOUR wallet over the exec_prepare `unsigned` artifact — never by this server.

venue.description: Venue id. One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

signature.description: YOUR wallet signature over the exec_prepare `unsigned` artifact.

credentials.description: Venue-specific submit fields (e.g. Polymarket CLOB apiKey/apiSecret/apiPassphrase). Forwarded to the venue relay, never persisted by the server.

confirm.description: MUST be exactly true to actually submit. Omitted or false = DRY RUN (submits nothing).

tools.name: exec_venues
tools.description: List the venues whose EXECUTION lanes are armed right now, with per-venue build/submit/cancel/modify/redeem flags and gating notes. Call this BEFORE exec_prepare: a venue can serve catalog and book data yet have no trading lane, and lanes are armed and darked over time. Requires an API key with the `trade` scope.

tools.name: exec_orders
tools.description: Read THIS account's execution state on one venue. `kind`: `order` (one execution plus its fills, by executionId), `list` (executions filtered by `status` open/closed/all), `trades` (this account's fills), `positions` (native lane positions, or the fills-derived fallback), `balance` (lanes without balance access answer an honest 501 NOT_SUPPORTED). Pure reads — nothing is built, signed, or submitted. `limit` and `cursor` apply to `list` and `trades` ONLY: positions and balance are unpaginated server-side, so passing them there is REFUSED rather than silently dropped.

venue.description: Venue id. One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

cursor.description: kind=list/trades only. Opaque cursor from the prior page.

tools.name: exec_refresh
tools.description: Re-read one execution's status DIRECTLY from the venue and update the stored record. The execution service stores no venue credential, so venues that need one take it here as a transient `credentials` object that is used for this call and never persisted. This changes no order — it only refreshes what we know about it. Use it when a submitted order looks stale.

venue.description: Venue id. One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

credentials.description: Venue-specific read credentials (e.g. Polymarket CLOB apiKey/apiSecret/apiPassphrase). Forwarded for this call only, never stored.

tools.name: exec_cancel
tools.description: BUILD an UNSIGNED cancel intent for an existing execution. This does NOT cancel anything by itself: it returns an unsigned artifact + executionId, exactly like exec_prepare. Sign the returned `unsigned` artifact with YOUR OWN wallet, then relay it with exec_submit — that is the call that actually cancels. The server holds no signing key. A cancel can legitimately come back already-filled; check exec_orders afterwards.

venue.description: Venue id. One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

order.description: Optional venue-shaped cancel-build input, forwarded verbatim.

tools.name: exec_modify
tools.description: BUILD an UNSIGNED modify intent for a RESTING execution (Hyperliquid lane). Like exec_cancel this changes nothing on its own: it returns an unsigned artifact to sign with YOUR OWN wallet and relay through exec_submit. Venues without a modify lane answer honestly — check exec_venues first.

venue.description: Venue id. One of: polymarket, kalshi, opinion, hyperliquid, limitless, polymarket_us, myriad, gemini, rain, predictfun, sxbet, pascal, xo, pred, predictstreet, novig.

order.description: Venue-shaped modify input (new price/size/order type), forwarded verbatim.

tools.name: get_funding_artifacts
tools.description: Funding and bridge reads that RETURN CALLER-SIGNABLE artifacts. Nothing is signed or broadcast here — every transaction comes back unsigned for YOUR wallet. `kind=transfer-plan` returns the ordered legs to move collateral between two venues (venues are custody islands; nothing moves through Predictefy, and the withdraw leg binds its own timestamp, so request a fresh plan rather than reusing one). `kind=bridge-quote` returns a route quote including unsigned transaction fields. `kind=bridge-session` polls one session, whose payload includes the unsigned payment transaction. For requirements or plain transfer progress use get_funding instead.

kind.description: Which artifact-bearing funding read to run.

amount.description: kind=transfer-plan: human decimal amount withdrawn from fromVenue.

owner.description: kind=transfer-plan: the caller's own address (destination, payer, approver).

exchange.description: kind=transfer-plan: destination exchange for the final finite approval.

sessionId.description: kind=bridge-session: the session id to poll.

tools.name: prepare_funding
tools.description: BUILD the caller-signable steps that get collateral onto a venue. Nothing is signed or broadcast here — every transaction comes back UNSIGNED for YOUR wallet. `kind=steps` returns the ordered finite approval/transfer transactions for a venue (Polymarket returns Polygon transactions; Hyperliquid reports first-party spot readiness). `kind=bridge-session` opens a bridge session from a quote — branch on the returned `paymentAction`. `kind=bridge-payment` reports the hash AFTER you broadcast the caller-signed transaction so the provider can track it. Poll progress with get_funding.

venue.description: kind=steps: the venue being funded.

amount.description: kind=steps (polymarket): positive human decimal, at most six decimals.

exchange.description: kind=steps (polymarket): destination exchange for the finite approval.

owner.description: kind=steps (hyperliquid): master account whose spot balance is read.

targetAmount.description: kind=steps (hyperliquid): desired first-party spot USDC balance.

toVenue.description: kind=bridge-session: destination venue selected during the quote.

paymentCurrency.description: kind=bridge-session: CAIP-19 payment currency from the bridge quote.

paymentTransactionHash.description: kind=bridge-payment: hash of the transaction YOU broadcast.
